visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The animation begins with a cartoon girl with dark hair in two buns, wearing a pink dress. She stands against a plain white background with her arms crossed, looking extremely annoyed with furrowed brows and a small frown. (2) The scene cuts to an elderly woman sitting in a wooden rocking chair. She wears a red dress and has grey hair tied up. The background has a textured, vintage paper appearance. She looks calm and is speaking with her eyes closed. (3) The visual style shifts dramatically to a high-contrast black and white background with radiating lines. The girl is shown in a close-up, shouting with an exaggerated, angry expression, her mouth wide open and teeth bared. (4) A montage follows showing the girl aggressively interacting with a small, brown, bean-shaped character representing her husband. In one frame, she is shaking him violently against a background of orange flames. In another, she is hitting him on the head. (5) The girl is then seen packing the brown character into a large cardboard box. She holds a roll of yellow packing tape and applies it to the top of the box to seal it. (6) The final scene shows the girl from behind, looking up at a purple night sky filled with white stars and small clouds. She has a frustrated expression with a 'vein' symbol on her head, looking towards the horizon.

(5) The sound of adhesive tape being pulled from a roll and applied to a surface is clearly audible. The young female voice continues her high-arousal rant without pausing.
